Analysis

Era 5 of 8

1994 to 2000: Humanitarian wars and failures

Opened by: Rwanda genocide, war in Bosnia.

Africa 38%, Europe 26%. "Humanitarian" in 46%. A tribunal for Rwanda (955 (1994)). Protection of civilians becomes an agenda item (1265 (1999)). Only 7 drafts are vetoed.

442resolutions
63per year
86%adopted unanimously
7vetoed drafts
26%under Chapter VII

Where the Council looked

Region of the situationShare
Africa38%
Middle East14%
Europe26%
Asia6%
Americas5%
Thematic1%
Institutional7%
Other2%

What rose in the texts

Subjects whose share of resolutions grew by 5 points or more on the previous era.

  • Refugees and displacement: 9% to 28%
  • Humanitarian access and aid: 27% to 46%
  • Human rights: 3% to 22%
  • Peacekeeping: 17% to 26%
  • Justice and impunity: 3% to 12%
  • Children and armed conflict: 1% to 6%

Vetoes

7 vetoed drafts. No votes by permanent members on them: USSR / Russia 1, United States 4, China 2. 3 further drafts failed for lack of votes.
